# Grill With Docs

Use this skill to run a disciplined interrogation session that challenges an implementation plan against authoritative documentation (ADRs, CONTEXT.md, and contracts).

## When to Use
- Pre-implementation grilling sessions for major features or architectural changes
- Validating proposals against domain models and ADR constraints
- Crystallizing terminology and contract boundaries

## When NOT to Use
- Minor bug fixes or isolated typo corrections
- Routine test maintenance
